title: nan
authors: Gubbi J.; Sandeep N.K.; Reddy K.P.K.; Balamuralidhar P.
key_contribution: Presents a robust ArUco-based visual marker enhanced with Reed-Solomon error correction for visual navigation of unmanned vehicles in GPS-denied indoor environments, tested under varied conditions.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
